entries.profile_scope: failed v5 envelope and checked v5 schema profile
entries.expected_invariant: Translate each Chinese target; never accept the generic Russian example phrase as the target translation.
entries.last_outcome: Literal prompt copy absent in the checked schema profile; semantic review remains open.

entries.profile_scope: checked v5 scene profiles on 1.8B and 7B
entries.expected_invariant: Preserve the singular or plural actor stated in the same-scene Chinese source; do not force singular in the explicit two-person negative control.
entries.last_outcome: The singular actor defect recurred in checked 1.8B and 7B short screens; human review is missing.

entries.profile_scope: v5 scene profile with later v6 target-bound control
entries.expected_invariant: Never accept or publish a model response with a segment or line ID different from the declared target; retain the raw response and committed prefix.
entries.last_outcome: The v5 wrong slot was rejected with zero result; v6 bound cue 72 in one later observation.

entries.expected_invariant: A bounded long-file translation may use its remaining declared total wall budget; an unbounded legacy run keeps the default process timeout.
entries.last_outcome: The hidden process cap was fixed; copied-state recovery later completed structurally but failed quality.

entries.profile_scope: copied v6 durable state and relocation helper
entries.expected_invariant: Only a verified copy may rewrite its own managed-source locator; the original state and source remain byte-identical, and all run checkpoints and attempts remain unchanged.
entries.last_outcome: Verified copied-source relocation passed later continuation; original state remained unchanged.

entries.profile_scope: 1.8B v6 target-bound model with paired 7B screen
entries.expected_invariant: Never accept a truncated or repetitive model answer as a translation; retain the raw response and the durable prefix without publishing a partial subtitle.
entries.last_outcome: The 1.8B length failure remains; both models passed JSON in a separate 16-request short screen.

entries.expected_invariant: A target that explicitly states a meeting proceeds today must retain that day; structural JSON validity alone is not evidence of fact preservation.
entries.last_outcome: Both sampled 1.8B outputs omitted today; 7B kept it in two sampled outputs, without human review.

entries.profile_scope: v6 post-length CLI harness, independent of model weights
entries.expected_invariant: Postflight CLI inspect, template and offline export must start with an explicit inherited environment after a validated long run, without a model request or changed checkpoint.
entries.last_outcome: The child-process harness and offline postflight passed; a new omitted-environment negative control rejects before spawn.

entries.profile_scope: 1.8B v6 long-file baseline, opt-in checked v6 guard
entries.expected_invariant: An exact ASCII source identifier must appear with the same multiplicity in its translated target line; a warning must survive checkpoint reopen.
entries.last_outcome: 665 long-file lines lost or changed codes; advisory warning and opt-in strict guard pass fixture checks, but the model fact gate remains open.
